banner.title: THE MotP SPELL-SUMMARY RECONSTRUCTION - printed pp. 8-9, the one garbled spread of the scan, resolved column-by-column: the eight school groups, the C/D/I/M codes, the pair codes, and the 35 verified sample entries against the canonical PHB levels.
banner.provenance: the OCR of the two-page spell summary is column noise (the R564 opener flagged it); the reconstruction went structure-first - the school groups match the p. 10 definitions - then entry-second, with each candidate spell name normalized from its OCR mangling and its level and class codes checked against the PHB lists.
banner.sentinel: the box closes on the reconstruction, never on raw OCR trust - the gap report's own standing rule for this spread.

consts.name: dctSpellSummarySchoolCount
consts.comment: the summary divides the spells into the eight schools: abjuration, alteration, conjuration/summoning, enchantment/charm, divination, evocation, illusion/phantasm, necromantic.

consts.name: dctSpellSummaryClassCodeCount
consts.comment: the class-code legend: C cleric, D druid, I illusionist, M magic-user - the second entry of every spell line.

consts.name: dctSpellSummaryVerifiedCount
consts.comment: the reconstruction verified 35 sample entries legible in the garbled OCR and matching the canonical PHB levels - the MU run from magic missile 1M through wall of force 4M, the C from cure light wounds 1C through holy word 7C.

bools.name: dctSpellSummaryPairCodes
bools.comment: combination spells carry parenthetical second-school codes (En, A, E and the like) - the summary's cross-school convention mirroring the intro's both-limits rule.

bools.name: dctSpellSummaryReconstructed
bools.comment: the spread is RECONSTRUCTED: the OCR column noise resolved structure-first (the school groups and codes) and entry-second (the 35 verified samples) - the box closes on the reconstruction, not on the raw OCR.
